facts.statement: Allbirds describes its shoes as lightweight, bouncy, comfortable, and supportive.
facts.quote: Lightweight, bouncy, and wildly comfortable, Allbirds shoes make any outing feel effortless. Slip in, lace up, or slide them on and enjoy the comfy support.

facts.statement: Allbirds says it uses wool, tree fiber, and sugarcane as natural material alternatives to petroleum-based synthetics.
facts.quote: We replace petroleum-based synthetics with natural alternatives wherever we can. Like using wool, tree fiber, and sugarcane.

facts.statement: Allbirds' store implements the Universal Commerce Protocol for product discovery, carts, and checkout.
facts.quote: This store implements the \[Universal Commerce Protocol\](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout.

facts.statement: Allbirds provides an MCP endpoint that exposes tools and schemas for shopping workflows.
facts.quote: Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.allbirds.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.

facts.statement: Allbirds' UCP tools support finding products, managing carts, preparing checkout, and completing buyer-authorized purchases.
facts.quote: Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases.

facts.statement: Allbirds' checkout page exposes UCP tools through WebMCP for the current browser session.
facts.quote: The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

facts.statement: Allbirds shoes are described as lightweight, bouncy, and comfortable, with support for slipping in, lacing up, or sliding on.
facts.quote: Lightweight, bouncy, and wildly comfortable, Allbirds shoes make any outing feel effortless. Slip in, lace up, or slide them on and enjoy the comfy support.

facts.statement: Allbirds says it replaces petroleum-based synthetics with natural alternatives such as wool, tree fiber, and sugarcane.
facts.quote: We replace petroleum-based synthetics with natural alternatives wherever we can. Like using wool, tree fiber, and sugarcane.

facts.statement: In 2016, Allbirds combined traditional-material comfort with a modern minimalist design and sustainable branding.
facts.quote: In 2016, Allbirds combined the comfort of traditional materials with a modern minimalist design and sustainable branding.

facts.statement: The source says Allbirds shifted many product lines from wool to Lyocell derived from wood pulp and later to recycled plastic.
facts.quote: Ironically, Allbirds has shifted away from wool for many of their product lines, which now use Lyocell derived from wood pulp. More recently they moved into recycled plastic.

facts.statement: The Men's Cruiser is a minimal, modern court shoe designed for urban comfort and movement.
facts.quote:
Why we made this

Minimal and modern, our signature classic court shoe delivers the right balance of style and urban comfort. Lightweight, breathable, and made to move, this is your new go-to for life on the go.

facts.quote:

facts.quote: Yes, they’re machine washable. Remove the insoles, hand wash those separately, and let everything air dry. Fresh again.

facts.statement: Allbirds held nine funding rounds by 2021 and raised a total of $255 million.
facts.quote: By 2021 they held a total of 9 funding rounds, raising $255 million.

facts.statement: In 2021, Allbirds sold $348 million worth of shares on the stock market.
facts.quote: Allbirds went to the stock market selling $348 million worth of shares, way more than expected.

facts.statement: The Securities and Exchange Commission forced Allbirds to remove the word “sustainable” from its IPO label.
facts.quote: The US government was not buying it and the Securities and Exchange Commission forced Allbirds to drop the “sustainable” label from their IPO altogether.

facts.statement: In 2025, Allbirds claimed to have created zero-carbon shoes and sold a limited run of 500 pairs.
facts.quote: In 2025, they claimed to have done it only to sell a limited run of 500 pairs.

facts.statement: In early 2026, Allbirds sold its intellectual property rights for $39 million to the American Exchange Group.
facts.quote: In early 2026, they sold off Allbirds intellectual property rights for $39M, a fraction of its former billion dollar valuation. The new owner is the American Exchange Group
